lines.text: Instructions regarding transfers of employees facing vigilance enquiries or disciplinary proceedings were issued in AP-GAD01-CIRMEMO-GAD01SERA0-3-2023-D20230814, dated 14-08-2023.
Guidelines for general transfers of employees for the year 2025 were issued in AP-FIN01-GOMS-31-2025, dated 12-05-2025.
Clarifications on the computation of station period for general transfers 2025 were issued in AP-FIN01-MEMO-FIN01HRPLG0TRF-3-2025-2-D20250521, dated 21-05-2025.
In File USD01-12/31/2022-ESTT.I, Note #5, on 20-06-2022, the transfer was approved and orders were issued.
In File USD01-12/77/2023-ESTT.I, Note #5, on 02-09-2023, the transfer was not agreed at present as the ban on transfers was in force.
In File USD01-12/44/2025-ESTT.I, Note #5, on 27-05-2025, the transfer was approved.
The ban on transfers is relaxed for the period from 15-05-2025 to 31-05-2025.
Transfers in any category shall not exceed 15% of the cadre strength of that category, and no relaxation of this ceiling shall be made without the prior concurrence of the Finance Department.
Spouse cases, where both spouses are State Government employees, shall be given preference subject to availability of vacancy.
The competent authority for transfers of Section Officers and below in the Secretariat Departments shall be the Secretary to Government of the Department concerned.
After 31-05-2025, the ban on transfers shall come into force again, and no transfer shall thereafter be ordered without the prior approval of the Government in the Finance Department.

Review recommended to verify applicability before approval, as there is a potential conflict relying on AP-FIN01-GOMS-88-2022 (03-06-2022) which appears superseded by AP-FIN01-GOMS-31-2025 (12-05-2025).
Review recommended to verify the authority, as there is a potential conflict relying on AP-FIN01-GOMS-104-2026 which was not found among indexed records.
Review recommended to confirm if the transfer can be made at this time, as the proposal is dated 22-09-2026, which is outside the relaxation period from 15-05-2025 to 31-05-2025.

Review recommended to submit the proposal to the Secretary to Government, as the proposal seeks approval by the Deputy Secretary who can only recommend, whereas the competent authority is the Secretary to Government.
It is submitted that giving preference to spouse cases subject to availability of vacancy may kindly be considered.
It is submitted that obtaining the prior approval of the Government in the Finance Department for transfers ordered after 31-05-2025 may kindly be considered.
It is submitted that submitting the proposal to the Secretary to Government as the competent authority may kindly be considered.
